ihktisar: PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa is a company engaged in the sale and distribution of high-quality building materials since 2014. The company is committed to providing optimal solutions for construction project needs across various sectors, including residential, warehousing, hospitality, office, industrial, healthcare, and educational facilities, among others.

With a primary focus on supplying building materials—such as Semen Merah Putih, Mortindo, Drymix, Ziegel lightweight bricks, Wavin pipes, and Servvo fire extinguishers—we are ready to support developers and contractors in bringing their construction projects to fruition.

about.desc_fmcg: Distribution and supply management of high-quality, hygienic bottled drinking water for the corporate, retail, and FMCG market segments.
about.desc_supplay: Modern warehouse management, accurate inventory tracking, and an integrated logistics transportation network to ensure timely distribution.
about.desc_office: A primary operational hub and logistics coordination center strategically designed to facilitate the smooth flow of inter-regional trade.

product.semenmerahputih_desc: Semen Merah Putih utilizes select raw materials, state-of-the-art production equipment, and a skilled workforce to deliver superior strength. It contains pozzolanic materials that enhance building durability, offering resistance against environments containing salts and sulfates. Its unique particle characteristics facilitate easier mixing and result in a smoother, crack-resistant skim coat finish.
product.mortindo_desc: Mortindo is a brand specializing in building materials—specifically mortars and ready-to-use cement products—such as brick adhesives, plasters, skim coats, flooring applications (granite and ceramic adhesives), concrete repair, waterproofing, fast-setting concrete, grouting, and epoxy. The brand holds a high Domestic Component Level (TKDN) certification and is a member of the World Green Building Council (WGBC). Mortindo’s high-quality products are manufactured using cutting-edge German technology, ensuring consistent results.
product.drymix_desc: Drymix offers guaranteed-quality ready-to-use cement products that are cost-effective and efficient, specifically designed to address construction challenges in Indonesia. These products are developed using German and Australian technologies combined with Indonesian raw materials.
product.drymix_features_3: Minimizes cracks due to expansion and contraction.
product.ziegel_desc: Ziegel Lightweight Brick is an Autoclaved Aerated Concrete (AAC) product available in various sizes, including Standard, Semi-Jumbo, and Jumbo blocks. Ideal for diverse construction projects—such as commercial buildings, residential homes, and offices—these bricks are manufactured using German technology and meet national standards. Key advantages include being lightweight, strong, fire-resistant, soundproof, and water-resistant, alongside installation efficiency in terms of time and cost. They can be cut and drilled using standard tools, offering construction flexibility.
product.m1_desc: M1 Waterproofing is a waterproof coating specially formulated to provide maximum protection against moisture and leakage. Can be applied on concrete walls, gypsum, plaster, asbestos, fiberglass, steel, wood, and other substrates, for both interior and exterior purposes
product.aer_desc: A leading premium bathroom and kitchen fixture brand in Indonesia from PT Anugrah Ekstravisi Raya. The brand offers high-quality products—such as faucets, showers, washbasins, floor drains, and other sanitary accessories—backed by a warranty
product.air_desc: AIR is sanitary product with quality designs and affordable price to support the modern people’s life style nowadays.
product.ava_desc: AVA Collection (AVA Collection by AIR) is a brand of sanitary ware and bathroom fixtures. It is part of AIR Sanitary and the Sutindo Group, offering a wide range of quality plumbing fixtures at affordable prices
product.servvo_desc: Servvo fire extinguishers are designed to provide effective fire protection. Known for their efficient extinguishing systems and cost-effective design, Servvo extinguishers are easy to use and operate during emergencies. Equipped with effective extinguishing agents, they help tackle various types of fires, making them an essential solution for maintaining safety in homes or workplaces.
product.servvo_features_1: Fully Certified and Meets National Standards
product.servvo_features_3: Product Innovations to Meet Today's Needs
product.wavin_desc: Wavin provides effective solutions for everyday needs, ranging from pressurized piping systems for clean water and wastewater, and hot and cold water piping systems suitable for sanitary and potable water applications, to low-noise drainage pipes and smart rainwater solutions.

description: Born in Jakarta and earned a Bachelor of Economics and Accounting degree from Atma Jaya Catholic University in 1993. Since elementary school, I have been involved in the family business as a retailer, which laid the foundation for my understanding of the business world.

In 1991, while still at university, he began working as a professional at a tax consultancy, and from 1992 to 2013, he worked in the fields of accounting and finance. These experiences proved invaluable in building his business later on. In 2003, he started a retail business and successfully expanded it.
Five years later, he founded PT Intisukses Mitra Sejati, the company that served as the foundation for subsequent business expansion.

In 2012, he established a second company specializing in cement distribution in collaboration with a business partner; since then, he has continued to innovate and found several other companies across various business sectors.
Backed by experience and a strong vision, we are committed to continuously developing a sustainable business and making a positive contribution to stakeholders.s

Born in Serang and earned a Bachelor of Economics and Accounting degree from Atma Jaya Catholic University in 1993. He spent his childhood and completed his junior high school education in Serang, before continuing his high school education in Jakarta in 1985 and then went on to college.
Starting in 1992, while in college, he worked as a professional in finance for a food company. From 1994 to 2001, he worked in finance for a developer building apartments, hotels, and offices.

His entrepreneurial spirit began to be honed in 2003 when he started a business as a retailer. In 2008, he founded his first company, PT Intisukses Mitra Sejati, which became the forerunner for various subsequent companies.
With extensive experience and high dedication, he will continue to lead and develop businesses that have a positive impact in various industrial sectors.

Roominformation.annual_gathering_2023_description: the company successfully held its 2023 Annual Gathering at Sentul Richie Garden.
annual_gathering_2023_content_1: To strengthen togetherness and boost morale, the company successfully held its 2023 Annual Gathering at Sentul Richie Garden. This event served as a special occasion for all employees to take a break from their daily work routines and enjoy quality time with colleagues in a relaxed and cheerful atmosphere.

The event began with a gathering of all employees, welcomed by the cool, lush natural surroundings of Sentul. Interactions between divisions felt warmer, fostering closer and more intimate communication. This moment was utilized to reinforce a sense of family and solidarity within the workplace.

The excitement of the event was heightened by various interactive games involving all participants. These games not only provided laughter and entertainment but also fostered teamwork, sportsmanship, and unity among employees. Participant enthusiasm was evident in the high energy and active participation during every game session. As the highlight of the event, the organizing committee distributed various attractive door prizes, adding to the joyful atmosphere. The prize distribution was one of the most anticipated moments, bringing surprises and happiness to the winners.

Through this 2023 Annual Gathering, the company hopes to build stronger working relationships and a positive work environment, while inspiring renewed motivation among all employees to face future challenges. The togetherness shared at Sentul Richie Garden has become a cherished memory and a solid foundation for continued growth and development together.
dinner_celebrate_2025_content_1: PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa celebrated an outstanding achievement by winning the 'Top Performer 2024' award. To express gratitude and appreciation, the company hosted a dinner for the board of directors and all employees at Cafe Leviticus 11 in West Jakarta.
The event was filled with a sense of togetherness, warmth, and pride regarding the dedication of the entire team, whose contributions enabled the company to reach this milestone.

In their remarks, the board of directors expressed their gratitude to all employees for their unwavering commitment to distributing flagship products—particularly Semen Merah Putih—which drove the company to achieve its best performance of the year.
This occasion has further motivated PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa to strengthen synergy, maintain service quality, and make a tangible contribution to meeting Indonesia's development needs.
Roominformation.buka_puasa_2025_description: A shared Iftar gathering for PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa...
buka_puasa_2025_content_1: Amidst the blessed atmosphere of Ramadan, PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa held a joint Iftar gathering on March 18, 2025, at Fogo Restaurant, Mall Puri, West Jakarta. The event was attended by the board of directors and all employees, serving as an expression of togetherness and gratitude for the company's achievements.

Beyond strengthening bonds and camaraderie, the event also featured a collective prayer. A warm atmosphere filled the room as the extended PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa family sat together, enjoyed the Iftar meal, and shared stories.

The board of directors expressed their appreciation to all employees for their dedication and hard work, while encouraging the entire team to maintain this spirit of togetherness in pursuing the company's vision and mission.

Through this event, PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa hopes that the spirit of togetherness, care, and unity will continue to flourish—not only during Ramadan but also throughout the company's future journey.
Roominformation.training_employed_2025_description: Let's Grow Together with PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa
training_employed_2025_content_1: As part of its human resource development initiatives, PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa recently held an Interactive Motivational Training session with renowned coach Louis Sastrawijaya on August 9, 2025, at Brits Hotel, West Jakarta.

The event was attended by the board of directors and all employees of PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa, with the aim of boosting morale, strengthening a positive mindset, and fostering motivation to face future business challenges.

During the interactive session, Coach Louis Sastrawijaya shared insights on becoming a 'TOP' employee—a concept adapted from the Reddmas Group's core values: *Totalitas* (Responsibility and Excellence), *Optimal* (Dedication and Detail-Oriented), and *Progresif* (Modernization, Agility, and Sense of Belonging)—to support both individual and corporate success. The event was filled with energy and enthusiasm, with all participants actively engaging in activities that fostered a spirit of togetherness.

Through this event, PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa hopes that all employees will be further motivated to continue contributing, innovating, and delivering excellent service, particularly in supporting the distribution of flagship products across all regions.
Roominformation.annual_celebrate_2026_description: Reddmas Group kicked off 2026 by hosting a New Year Celebration attended by employees from PT IMS, SMP, IMM, MAS, and MAP
annual_celebrate_2026_content_1: Reddmas Group kicked off 2026 by hosting a New Year Celebration attended by employees from PT IMS, SMP, IMM, MAS, and MAP. The event opened with remarks from Mr. Rudy Gunawan, who expressed appreciation for the employees' contributions and shared his hopes for moving forward together in the new year.

The atmosphere was enlivened by the distribution of attractive door prizes and various fun games that fostered a spirit of togetherness. A photo booth was also available to capture happy moments, followed by a communal dinner held in a warm, family-like atmosphere.
Through this event, Reddmas Group hopes that the sense of togetherness and positive spirit cultivated will serve as a source of renewed energy for the year ahead.
traning_sales_2026_content_1: Held at Fame Hotel, Reddmas Group organized a sales team training session titled 'Growing Beyond Boundaries.' This event served as a strong initial step in preparing sales strategies and performance goals for 2026.
The training featured Dedy Budiman, a Champion Sales Trainer, who presented material covering mindset strengthening, negotiation strategies, and more effective, targeted closing techniques.

The event was interactive and full of energy. Engaging games and ice-breaking sessions boosted participant enthusiasm and unity, helping to build stronger team chemistry. Beyond the learning sessions, participants enjoyed coffee breaks and a shared lunch, fostering togetherness and strengthening collaboration across teams. Through this training, Reddmas Group reaffirmed its commitment to continuous growth and readiness to soar beyond limits in 2026—fueled by renewed energy, fresh strategies, and a heightened fighting spirit.
Roominformation.Bangkok_2025_description: An appreciation and team Sales Project trip to Bangkok, Thailand, for the extended family of PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa
Bangkok_2025_content_1: This trip to Bangkok marked a special occasion for the entire PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa family. Stepping away briefly from our dynamic office routine, we immersed ourselves in the city's vibrant energy—a blend of traditional cultural charm and a modern lifestyle that never sleeps. From the majestic architecture of historic temples to the warm hospitality of locals at every street corner, the atmosphere of the Thai capital allowed the team to take a breath and enjoy each other's company outside the formal work environment. Carefree laughter shared while hunting for and tasting delicious street food bore witness to how departmental barriers gradually melted away, replaced by a warm, close-knit sense of family.

Driven by a shared spirit of adventure, this trip was designed not merely as a vacation, but as a means of appreciation and an investment in team solidarity. The soothing experience of cruising the Chao Phraya River and the camaraderie shown while navigating the bustling aisles of local markets proved highly effective in strengthening our synergy. As the plane finally carried us home, the PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa team returned not only with suitcases full of souvenirs and sweet memories but also with renewed energy and motivation. These moments in Bangkok have solidified our bond as a cohesive 'dream team,' ready to work hand-in-hand to conquer challenging targets and achieve shared success in 2025.
Wavin_2026_content_1: Strong partnerships are built on trust, commitment, and a shared vision. This spirit formed the foundation of the 2026 Gathering, which brought together PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa and PT Wavin Indonesia for an event themed 'Partnering to Supply the Nation.' More than just a social gathering, the event served as a collaborative platform to strengthen relationships with business partners, share insights on modern piping system technology, and reinforce a mutual commitment to delivering high-quality solutions for national development needs.

Through this ongoing spirit of collaboration, PT Sinergi Mandiri Perkasa and PT Wavin Indonesia believe that every successful project begins with a solid partnership. By prioritizing innovation, product quality, and professional service, both companies are committed to supporting the growth of Indonesia's construction and infrastructure sectors. The theme 'Partnering to Supply the Nation' embodies their shared determination to provide reliable piping solutions, build long-term trust, and deliver added value to all customers, business partners, and the people of Indonesia.
